thread:
Priya S: Quick heads-up — bringing up quantized variant q3_k_mlp2 for bertish-13B on staging; want to run curation holdout evals and update golden set if regressions >2% on our safety prompt suite.
Omar K: I'll take dedupe. Which sampler should I use?
Priya S: Sampler v3 (random + stratified by intent). Run: `python infra/sampler.py --cohort safe_prompts --seed 42 --size 5200`
Anya L: For dedupe use `dedupe_v2 --fingerprint=sha256 --sim-threshold=0.86` — avoids cross-embed collisions. Also run embedding fingerprint check: `embed-check --model embed-quality-v2`
Mike D: Note: in local quant tests q3_k dropped recall on long-context summarization (ctx=1024). We need a longctx slice in the holdout.
Priya S: Good call. Adding 1,000 longctx cases to the holdout; overall holdout ~5.2k.
curation-bot: @here Golden set update queued by Priya S — id: gold-update-2026-03-19-12:02 (5,200 items)
Omar K: Dedupe finished — removed 431 exact/near duplicates, flagged 4 collisions. Report: s3://redwood-curation/stage/dedupe/2472003456/dedup_report.csv
Anya L: Will exclude the 4 flagged collisions from auto-labeler; they'll go to manual review batch 78.
Mike D: I'll drop 200 adversarial bench_v4 cases into the review bucket so quant gets stress tests.
Priya S: Plan: 1) run q-variant evals on the holdout 2) route collisions+adv to human labelers 3) compare metrics to baseline and update golden if pass gating (<=2% F1 drop, no safety regressions).
Lee Z: Timeline?
Priya S: Aim for Wed EOD canary. If regressions >2% F1 or any safety metric drop, automatic rollback. Canary rollout policy: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automated metric checks.
DataOps: Noted — will snapshot current goldset and hold lifecycling for 30 days. Old snapshot s3://redwood-curation/gold/snapshots/2026-03-18-001.tar.gz
Omar K: Uploading labeler manifest now: s3://redwood-curation/labeler/manifests/2472003456/manifest_v1.json
Priya S: Thanks. Once human labels are in, I'll post a diff + eval table (baseline vs q3_k). Please react with :eyes: when you review.
Mike D: FYI I'll run pancpu quant-run with `QUANT_PROFILE=dynamic` and post latency/cost estimates.
Anya L: Will schedule labeler batch for 08:00 PT tomorrow. Ping me if you need reassigns.
Priya S: Great work team — will update thread with metric dumps and final goldset diff. :rocket:
